text.ACTIVITY_PIRATE_HELP: 1. During the event you can trigger stories by tapping on the Girls' avatars on the event page. The story you trigger could be part of the main event story or a side story.|2. There're 5 locations available to check: Sea Lord's Palace Coastal Waters Open Sea The Beach and Abyssal Palace. After you complete all the main event stories in a location Raid feature will become available for the location.|3. All players will be able to claim a free reward after Story Progress reaches the requirement.|4. 1 Voyager Compass will be consumed for each Raid. You will get a fixed (according to your current location) reward 20 Pirate Coins and have a 20%% chance to get an additional random chest reward for each Raid.|5. You will get random types of chests as random rewards. Each type of Chest will provide you a different number of Pirate Coins:|Wooden Chest: 30 Pirate Coins|Iron Chest: 60 Pirate Coins|Silver Chest: 80 Pirate Coins|Gold Chest: 100 Pirate Coins|Platinum Chest: 120 Pirate Coins|6. You can review the completed main event stories in "Review".|7. Once the event ends the remaining "Voyager Compasses" and "Pirate Coins" will automatically be recycled into Coins at a rate of 500k per Voyager Compass and 1000 per Pirate Coin.
text.ACTIVITY_PIRATE_SHOP_TEXT04: Confirm to exchange with {1} Pirate Coins?
text.ACTIVITY_PIRATE_SHOP_TEXT05: 1. You can obtain Pirate Coins by Raiding in the event: Deep Sea Treasures.|2. Pirate Coins can be used to exchange rewards in the event: Palace Vaults.|3. Larger vaults will be unlocked after you consume a certain number of Pirate Coins.|4. You can view your current collection progress and reward details of the reward chests on the Collection Reward page.|5. All rewards claimable on the Collection Reward page can be claimed once only.
